paragraphs: Peniel the High Priest (Peniel, I Chronicles 8:25).
Gittin 58a relates that his daughter Tzafenat was taken captive. Her captor abused her all night; the next day he took her out to sell her, etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The parenthetical Biblical Peniel is not identified with this High Priest. The daughter’s captor, not an ethnic “Arab,” is the subject of the abuse and intended sale.

The checked Gittin 58a paragraphs name Tzafenat bat Peniel, describe her as a High Priest’s daughter, and relate the captor’s abuse and intended sale. “Captor” is not an ethnic designation. I Chronicles 8:25 separately displays a Peniel written form and Penuel reading; that Biblical parenthetical does not identify the Biblical figure with this High Priest.
